mostWorthwhile.text: Testing two simultaneous excitatory inputs was most worthwhile: the threshold trace contrasted clearly with the single-input response and showed that the outgoing spike is a new event.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the second excitatory connection was a fairly routine setup step; its picture did not yet show what the extra input changed.

surprise.text: The mixed-input trace dipped below its resting line even though both incoming neurons fired, illustrating a different quiet response from weak excitation alone.

arbitrary.text: Joining two input arrangements directly into grey matter felt somewhat abrupt: the resulting mesh showed its components but did not explain much about how those examples relate to the larger tissue.

continue.text: I would continue: the contrasting voltage traces made the neural integration question engaging, though I would want clearer explanations of glial roles and how the synaptic examples scale up to grey matter.
